system.description:
After missing an unarmed attack, you quickly fix your mistakes, using a jet on one of your legs or arms to quickly propel an attack forward. Make one unarmed attack against the original target. You can only cast this jutsu once per turn.

If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, this remade attack is made at advantage.

Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, due to how unpredictable this follow up attack is, if the target is benefiting from a Jutsu based effect that grants them a Bonus to their AC or DR, this jutsu’s attacks ignore those bonuses.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, increase the number of times you can use this jutsu per turn by +1.
